description: A custom `snapshotResolver` (B23d B1): Jest 30.5.2 loads it through the project's transform, writes the new snapshot where it says (`__snaps__/<file>.snap`), reads the stored one from there, and through its `resolveTestPath` reports `__snaps__/gone.test.ts.snap`, whose test file is not there, as an obsolete file (the run fails; without `-u` the file stays). One worker.

jest.__snaps__/stored.test.ts.snap:
// Jest Snapshot v1, https://jestjs.io/docs/snapshot-testing

exports[`read from where the resolver says 1`] = `"stored"`;
